title: Action Modifiers
description: Object keyed by action name. Each value is the modifier set consumed by evaluateOutcome() and updateState() in turn-resolution.js. All numeric fields are optional; missing fields normalize to 0 or safe defaults via getActionModifier().

progress.description: Additive offset to progressChance. Negative for descend (movement in reverse).

collapse.description: Additive offset to collapseChance (negative reduces collapse risk).

fatigueMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to fatigueDelta for this action.

exposureMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to exposureDelta for this action.

fatigueRecovery.description: Positive fatigue recovery applied to state.

exposureRecovery.description: Positive exposure recovery applied to state.

pressureDeltaCap.description: Caps effectiveDelta for this action (e.g. descend caps at 30).

campOnly.description: If true, action is only available at camp nodes.

timeReset.description: If set, minutesOfDay resets to this HH:MM time after the action.
